senate.description: Repeal the sunset of the disproportionate share facility rate floor

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; repealing the sunset of the disproportionate share facility rate floor; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 256S.205, subdivision 7.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REPEALER. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 256S.205, subdivision 7,+]

[+ is repealed. +]

APPENDIX
Repealed Minnesota Statutes: 26-06784

256S.205 CUSTOMIZED LIVING SERVICES; DISPROPORTIONATE SHARE RATE ADJUSTMENTS.

Subd. 7.
Expiration.
This section expires May 31, 2028.
